bft_vs_raft_sentence: Byzantine fault tolerance therefore cost 17% of anchor throughput relative to Raft on this host, and 26% of verified-update throughput.
BFT7_PARA: ZQHLZQ With seven orderers ($f_o=2$), all on the same two vCPUs, the BFT channel committed 59 anchor TPS (median latency 1649 ms) and 12.9 verified update TPS. The corresponding figures with four orderers were 92 and 20.5. The Raft channel with seven orderers reached 109 anchor TPS. Tolerating one more Byzantine orderer therefore has a measurable cost on a single host. This cost is expected to be smaller when orderers run on separate machines.
